module_catalog.name: Creative manuscript and documentation 895
module_catalog.content: The dissertation should demonstrate creative achievement in one of the following genres: poetry drama and screenplay prose (fiction), prose (creative non-fiction: biography or autobiography), or literary translation/adaptation. The creative component should be complete work, or set of complete shorter works and should in substance be the equivalent of at least (in fiction) a short novel or a collection of short stories, or (in poetry) a book-length collection of poems, or (in drama) a full-length play or a collection of at least three one-act plays. The theoretical component should be a scholarly/academic work on a related topic. *The language of tuition depends on the language in which the creative and theoretical components are written.
